correctness.rationale: Four-step constructive proof: every hub-free fort is a dominating fort on the path with endpoint and local-word constraints; every hub-containing fort comes from a dominating path set; its only possible hub-free proper subfort is the whole path fort, yielding exactly one odd alternating exclusion. An exact two-state transfer for all minimal path dominating sets yields the rational function. The standalone original-definition enumeration checks all 262121 subsets through n=16 and rational-series coefficients through n=100 without serving as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: Determines the entire minimal obstruction hypergraph of a natural infinite graph family, refining the earlier count of all successful forcing sets: two sharply distinct structural mechanisms, an odd-path crossing exception and a rational all-size count. The relation to minimal domination gives transfer and growth information of possible use in fort-covering formulations of forcing; the problem is more meaningful than a numerical update or rewording of a known scalar invariant.
